slides.heading: Design Fundamentals 3/4
slides.subtitle: Topics 13–18
slides.narration: Design fundamentals, part 3 of 4. We'll cover Specialized storage paradigms, Replication and sharding, Leader election, Peer-to-peer networks, Polling and streaming, and Configuration.

slides.heading: 13. Specialized storage paradigms
bullets: Blob storage (S3/GCS), time-series DBs (InfluxDB, Prometheus), graph DBs (Neo4j), spatial indexes (quadtrees, geohash)
slides.narration: Specialized storage paradigms. Blob storage (S3 or GCS), time-series DBs (InfluxDB, Prometheus), graph DBs (Neo4j), spatial indexes (quadtrees, geohash).

slides.heading: 14. Replication and sharding
bullets: sharding by range, hash or region
slides.narration: Replication and sharding. Sync versus async replicas. sharding by range, hash or region. hot spots. resharding with consistent hashing.

slides.heading: 15. Leader election
slides.narration: Leader election. One leader handles writes or jobs. consensus via Paxos or Raft. in practice use ZooKeeper or etcd leases.

slides.heading: 16. Peer-to-peer networks
bullets: Split a large file into chunks shared between peers (BitTorrent)
slides.narration: Peer-to-peer networks. Split a large file into chunks shared between peers (BitTorrent). gossip protocols. DHT for peer discovery.

slides.heading: 17. Polling and streaming
bullets: Polling at intervals vs a long-lived connection (WebSockets/SSE)
streaming suits chat and live data
slides.narration: Polling and streaming. Polling at intervals versus a long-lived connection (WebSockets or SSE). streaming suits chat and live data.

slides.heading: 18. Configuration
bullets: Static (deployed with the code, reviewed) vs dynamic (a config service, instant but riskier)
slides.narration: Configuration. Static (deployed with the code, reviewed) versus dynamic (a config service, instant but riskier).

slides.heading: Recap
slides.narration: To recap this part: Specialized storage paradigms; Replication and sharding; Leader election; Peer-to-peer networks; Polling and streaming; Configuration. Each of these shows up again in the design walkthroughs.
